Text_3AE99AE45A: LE MANS ULTIMATE  /  v1.6-preview · USB controller feedback
Text_806C22EC99: 1. Connect DualSense with a USB data cable and disable controller vibration from other software.
Text_16AF1B2544: 2. Select the controller audio device in “Road & vibration”; test both grips in “Connection & tools”.
Text_BA50D361BB: 3. Start LMU and begin driving, adjust feedback strength to taste, then save the configuration.
Text_8AD2E87E61: Output always switches automatically to the detected car. Editing another car does not change the current car’s feedback. Grip vibration, audio and appearance remain general.
Text_2E7F9205BA: R2 adds resistance when traction control (TC) intervenes, helping you feel wheelspin. Enable the option below to keep R2 free during normal acceleration.
Text_A79F010861: Automatic: GT3 uses legacy LT; other cars use light base resistance, critical-slip resistance and lockup pulses. Detection repeats whenever you change cars.
Text_0A29514732: Automatic: legacy GT3 / prediction for others
Text_1F555EDE24: No reference wall before calibration. Threshold cues need valid longitudinal contact-patch velocity. Travel mapping is linear by default; calibrate it to the game’s dead zone and curve.
Text_D0F3713361: Vehicle data drives independent road and kerb vibrations in each grip. Voice coils are the controller’s haptic vibration components.
Text_9A87D338FC: Use repeated bumps to supplement kerb detection
Text_B8EA8BC30D: Without a kerb marker, infer kerbs from repeated bumps on one side. Rough road may also trigger this; disable if preferred.
Text_68F1F21AB8: Disabling USB voice coils enables standard grip rumble. Keep game audio on headphones or speakers.
Text_0FE50CDBBC: Engine, gearshift, tyre slip and collision cues. Engine vibration follows RPM; road and kerb feedback take priority.
Text_05FB1DD36C: Adjust road and kerbs first, then add other effects to taste. The grip meters above show software output levels to help confirm output.
Text_B3E9372DD5: Leave driving mode, then test grip vibration and trigger resistance. Each test lasts 1 second. Confirm controller feedback before entering the game.
Text_14FE22EC16: Changes apply immediately. Save the configuration to keep them for the next launch. To investigate issues, record driving data and open the log folder. Feedback settings cannot change while recording.
Text_B7A9555934: Disable vibration output for this controller in Steam Input and other software. Use headphones or speakers for game audio.
